online_assessment.notes: Represents the zenith of algorithmic difficulty within the standard Big Tech recruiting cohort at IIT KGP. Designed to induce extreme cognitive load.

technical_rounds.primary_focus: Data Structures Internals and Advanced Algorithmic Modeling
specific_queries: Red-Black Tree implementation of std::map vs Hash Table implementation of std::unordered_map
Design of custom Hash Functions, specifically Rolling Hashes
2-sum problem systematically constrained until candidate must architect a 5-sum Dynamic Programming solution
Rigorous mathematical proofs for space and time complexities of the 5-sum DP solution
technical_rounds.key_insight: Interviewers probe internal memory architecture of the STL. Candidates must explain implementations, not just usage.

specific_queries: Deep OOP paradigms: polymorphism and inheritance mechanics
Hardware-level memory management: operational discrepancies between L1 and L2 caching mechanisms
Live coding: implement a fully functional Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache from scratch in a text editor
technical_rounds.key_insight: Aggressive pivot from algorithmic theory to systems-level understanding. Tests breadth across the full CS stack.

critical_topics: OOP deep dive (polymorphism, inheritance, virtual dispatch)
